+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M21AEPX6A1KRH0TQ0D4QV9CP

+position_ordinal: '9480'
+title: 'Item views: SystemPromptView, UserMessageView, AssistantMessageView, StructuredItemView, CompactionMarkerView, UnknownItemView, ErrorView (plan §9 A2)'
+---
+## What
+Create the default item views in `Sources/AgentViewKit/Items/`, per plan.md §9 A2. They replace the placeholders from the thread view task.
+
+- `SystemPromptView`: a collapsed disclosure labelled "Instructions" that reveals the text.
+- `UserMessageView` and `AssistantMessageView`: a header with role and time, the content blocks through `ContentBlockView`, and a footer slot for `MessageActions` (empty until that task).
+- `StructuredItemView`: the fallback for an unregistered `schemaName`: a disclosure with the name and a pretty-printed JSON body.
+- `CompactionMarkerView`: a divider row with the summary and a "show details" disclosure.
+- `UnknownItemView`: a disclosure with the raw kind and JSON.
+- `ErrorView(error)`: one block per case with an action: `contextSizeExceeded` shows the counts and offers Compact; `rateLimited` shows the reset time and offers Retry; `guardrailViolation` and `refusal` show the explanation and offer Rephrase; `timeout` offers Retry; an ACP error shows the code and message. Actions call closures the host passes; the default closures are no-ops.
+- Every view reads `AgentTheme` for spacing and fonts and applies accessibility labels.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Each view mounts for its record and exposes an accessibility label with the kind.
+- [ ] `ErrorView` shows the correct action title for each error case.
+- [ ] `SystemPromptView` is collapsed by default and expands on toggle.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Items/ItemViewsHostedTests.swift`: one mount per view; error action titles; disclosure toggle.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
